correctness.rationale: For fixed centre and k identified leaf neighbours, removing them bijects the marked event with a uniform Cayley core having a specified leaf; the remaining Prüfer code is an iid allocation on n-k-1 symbols. This gives both exact conditional empty-box law and joint expectation via indicator linearity. Strict elementary series bounds prove sign negative at k=1 and positive at every k>=2, with no finite-n extrapolation. The exact-rational checker enumerates every Cayley tree n=4..8, checks marked laws and moments, and checks the sign formula through n=250 (30,743 assertions). The fixed-k asymptotics follow from convergent expansions.

value.rationale: Total leaf count and exact pendant-star-centre profile are canonical statistics for uniform labelled trees; strict cherries have established automorphism motivation. The theorem supplies an all-finite-order sharp sign switch between one and two pendant leaves and an explicit joint conditional law, rather than isolated numerical gains. The non-comparability boundary prevents over-interpreting positive covariance as stochastic dominance. All parameters are natural and the result is nontrivial beyond the standard marginal Prüfer occupancy identity.
